name: e-tawelco
description: E-TAWELCO public site and role-based service dashboard

scripts.build: esbuild src/dashboard/main.js --bundle --platform=browser --alias:ws=./src/dashboard/ws-shim.js --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --define:SUPABASE_URL=\"$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\" --define:SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=\"$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY\" --outfile=dashboard/app.js && esbuild src/public-auth.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --define:SUPABASE_URL=\"$NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\" --define:SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=\"$SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY\" --outfile=public-auth.js && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public/dashboard public/assets && cp index.html public/index.html && cp public-auth.js public/public-auth.js && cp dashboard/index.html public/dashboard/index.html && cp dashboard/app.js public/dashboard/app.js && cp assets/* public/assets/
